handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Claude2 while Claude is dispatch-paused.

Implementation complete: GET /bff/v5/interventions, POST /bff/v5/interventions/{id}/remediate, GET /bff/approvals. Two-man preconditions enforced (TWO_MAN_REQUIRED/APPROVAL_REQUIRED/CONFIRM_TOKEN_REQUIRED). RemediateSentinelIntervention in action catalog and command executor. 14 focused tests pass; 439 total BFF tests pass. Commit: e2d1a99b.

Review requested changes: RemediateSentinelIntervention is cataloged with required_roles=[approver] but neither /bff/v5/interventions/{id}/remediate nor /bff/v1/commands enforces a validator for it, so a viewer-authenticated caller can receive 202 with arbitrary approval/two-man strings. Also command_executor catches downstream sentinel POST failures and returns status=remediated stub=True when PANTHEON_INTERNAL_API_URL is configured but unreachable; this is fail-open for a critical remediation. Please add role/shape validation plus regression tests and gate/remove the stub fallback so production/downstream failures fail closed.
All review-requested changes implemented. Role/shape validator added + fail-open stub removed. 80 tests pass (commit 32574279). Please re-review and approve.

Review changes requested: /bff/v1/commands currently accepts top-level twoManSignatureId/secondOperatorId evidence but stores only cmd.params, so accepted RemediateSentinelIntervention commands can execute with an empty downstream two_man_signature_id. Normalize supported two-man aliases from top-level payload into stored/execution params, or reject this command unless the evidence is present in params; add a regression covering accepted v1 RemediateSentinelIntervention with top-level twoManSignatureId propagating to stored/executor params. Verification run before reopen: python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/bff/test_v5_interventions.py services/control-plane/bff/test_command_executor.py services/control-plane/bff/test_governance_command_submission.py services/control-plane/bff/test_final_precondition_errors.py services/control-plane/bff/test_action_catalog.py -q (80 passed).

R2 fix complete: _stored_command_params now accepts raw_payload and normalizes twoManSignatureId/secondOperatorId/twoManApprovalId etc. from top-level v1/commands payload into params['two_man_signature_id'] for RemediateSentinelIntervention. Both v1/commands call sites updated. 2 regression tests added. 82 tests pass (commit 11dd738f). Please re-review and approve.
R2 review approved. Two-man alias propagation fix is correct; focused suite passed (82) and full BFF suite passed (457, 36 existing warnings). Owner Claude should finalize closeout to done.
